measurement_amendments.disposition: retained failed run; no failed cell is excluded
changes: Cap peak WAL and private staging bytes by the existing per-scale database-size limit instead of unvalidated global limits that were smaller than the accepted huge persistent footprint.

Retain process read-operation counts as raw diagnostics but remove the 512-operation gate because Windows Job accounting counts operating-system I/O operations, not SQLite statements; byte, indexed-row, hydration, and output bounds remain authoritative.

Accept typed refresh_required after a canceled dirty-source scan because serving an overview would violate the freshness contract; last-complete generation, writer release, reopen, integrity, cleanup, and survivor checks remain required.
Cap Rayon worker pools by admitted work cardinality before repeating the concurrent-isolation measurement.

measurement_amendments.disposition: retained failed run; all corpus, contention, cancellation, recovery, storage, and query gates passed; the concurrent resource proxy is corrected before repetition
changes: Divide the existing host worker budget equally across concurrent CLI processes through the public --max-workers control, which already owns repository traversal and parser work.

Retain raw OS-thread peaks as diagnostics but remove their hard gate because summed per-process peaks conflate controlled workers with fixed orchestration threads and are not an observed concurrent worker peak; hard-gate the exact configured aggregate worker budget, child-process bounds, terminal accounting, RSS, behavior, and retained-thread growth instead.

measurement_amendments.disposition: superseded publication retained in Git history; promotion review found that it predates release-affecting runtime, MCP, relation-service, and repository-graph changes
changes: Relock the runtime and MCP inventory identities and repeat the complete small, medium, huge, concurrency, contention, cancellation, and termination matrix against the corrected functional release candidate.

preflight_failures.disposition: no measurement executed; restored the unchanged single-process thread thresholds still used by per-case gates after removing only their misleading concurrent use

final_measurement_contract.process_io_metric_backend: Windows JobObjectBasicAndIoAccountingInformation for exact terminal tree CPU, cumulative process count, conservative worker bounds, and I/O plus psutil for sampled peak RSS, process, thread, and storage diagnostics; watch-edit baselines require 100 ms of unchanged exact Job accounting after readiness
final_measurement_contract.non_windows_disposition: skip smoke-only data and fail publication eligibility because terminal counters are incomplete

proof_ownership.repeated_query_matrix: repeated-call process I/O, latency, bounded output, and stable publication identity only

bounded intrusive writer-availability sampling with a conservative interval bound plus fail-fast contention and deterministic retry
cross-root concurrent publication, same-root writer race, final identity, generation, content, integrity, and cleanup
cooperative MCP task cancellation followed by CLI and MCP reopen with last-complete generation preservation
SQLite version, compile options, schema, journal, synchronous, busy, checkpoint, statistics, database, WAL, and persistent bytes
process-tree worker, thread, retained-thread, child-process, CPU-efficiency, and RSS bounds
default-core in-process scan parent termination plus separately owned real-pack Linux/Windows parser containment proof
failure_rules: Any correctness, freshness, migration, corruption, timeout, or nonzero-exit failure rejects the candidate.

Any whole-tree or whole-node-table amplification on repeated stable-publication bounded reads, or any full, unchanged, narrow, expanded-guidance, or rebuild absolute-transfer or database-adjusted-efficiency threshold breach rejects the candidate.

Any hot-query plan scan, temporary sort, missing owning index, unbounded retained materialization, worker or thread oversubscription, unexplained busy/lock failure, excessive publication writer-unavailable interval, or surviving canceled process rejects the candidate.

Any cross-root identity leak, same-root double publication, partial canceled generation, failed reopen, nonzero final WAL/stage state, or unexpected SQLite operating-profile drift rejects the candidate.
A threshold miss is reported and investigated; results are not silently excluded or thresholds changed after measurement.
